note: The view expressed several times by Jerome that Adam was buried in Hebron (Kiryat-Arba) also determined his translation of Jos 14:15. He traces the idea back to _Hebraei_ (Jews) (_The Life of Saint Paula_ = Letter 108, 11; CSEL 55: 319). – Pieter W. van der Horst: The Site of Adam’s Tomb. In: M.F.J. Baasten et al. (eds.): _Studies in Hebrew Literature and Jewish Culture_. Dordrecht 2007 (x, 320 pp.), pp. 251–255.
